integrity: Exact finite-field point/line enumeration and symbolic Jacobian calculations are included with replayable code and recorded outputs; no independent scientific validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: The exact rational-line classification concerns \(\mathbb F_5\)-lines only; the open complement is the reduced union of the 25 distinguished lines removed from the specified Weddle quartic, not its desingularization. The infinite-extension zeta formula relies on the standard odd-characteristic Weddle/Kummer birationality. A later study of Weddle schemes could not be inspected beyond its abstract, so historical priority is provisional.
title: A point-free line-complement on the characteristic-five Weddle quartic
